mapper.insert: insert into performance( seq, service_name, title, start_date, end_date, place, realm_name, area, sigungu, thumbnail, gps_x, gps_y ) values( #{seq}, #{serviceName}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{place}, #{realmName}, #{area}, #{sigungu}, #{thumbnail}, #{gpsX}, #{gpsY} ) on duplicate key update service_name = values(service_name), title = values(title), start_date = values(start_date), end_date = values(end_date), place = values(place), realm_name = values(realm_name), area = values(area), sigungu = values(sigungu), thumbnail = values(thumbnail), gps_x = values(gps_x), gps_y = values(gps_y), updated_at = current_timestamp

insert into performance_detail( seq, price, contents, url, phone, img_url, place_url, place_addr, place_seq ) values( #{seq}, #{price}, #{contents}, #{url}, #{phone}, #{imgUrl}, #{placeUrl}, #{placeAddr}, #{placeSeq} ) on duplicate key update price = values(price), contents = values(contents), url = values(url), phone = values(phone), img_url = values(img_url), place_url = values(place_url), place_addr = values(place_addr), place_seq = values(place_seq), updated_at = current_timestamp

select seq, service_name, title, start_date, end_date, place, realm_name, area, sigungu, thumbnail, gps_x, gps_y from performance
and ( title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or place like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or area like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or sigungu like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or realm_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or service_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and (realm_name = #{realm} or service_name = #{realm})
order by case when end_date is null then 1 when end_date >= current_date then 0 else 1 end, start_date asc, seq desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select count(*) from performance
and ( title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or place like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or area like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or sigungu like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or realm_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or service_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and (realm_name = #{realm} or service_name = #{realm})
select realm_name from performance where realm_name is not null and realm_name != '' group by realm_name order by count(*) desc, realm_name asc

select p.seq, p.service_name, p.title, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.place, p.realm_name, p.area, p.sigungu, p.thumbnail, p.gps_x, p.gps_y, d.price, d.contents, d.url, d.phone, d.img_url, d.place_url, d.place_addr, d.place_seq from performance p left join performance_detail d on p.seq = d.seq where p.seq = #{seq}
